messages:
jamie_finance: Kicking off a small pricing experiment for the "compact-credits" price sheet. Target go-live 2026-07-12 08:00 UTC. Scope: minor per-embedding tweak + credits rebalance for mid-size teams. Need invoice-preview, grandfathering policy (proposed 3 weeks), and exception handling.

miguel_billing: Please publish exact cohort filter (plan_ids + tag excludes). I also request adding `experiment_tag` on invoice lines for easier reconciliation.

tara_sales: Exclude negotiated/enterprise accounts. I'll export AM-owned list and flag any that want an opt-out. No surprise billing for them.

eli_ops: Staging SQL to validate cohort:
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-07-12' AND '2026-08-02'
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%'
  AND c.negotiated = false;
```
Will push CSV to /finance-drive.

billing-bot: invoice-preview job started for cohort compact-credits-expt.

miguel_billing: Running preview: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort compact-credits-expt --sample 60`. Posting CSV when done.

billing-bot: invoice-preview complete  60 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/compact-credits-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Found 9 subscriptions with manual rate overrides and 3 with legacy promo credits. Proposal: flag overrides as `manual-grandfather` and issue one-time credits for promo gaps. Need sign-off on credit calculation method (pro-rate remaining period).

sophie_legal: OK to use one-time credits for bona fide promo mismatches. Legal needs the comms copy with explicit "no retroactive charges" and an opt-out link. I'll review copy by Fri EOD.

eli_ops: Ops checklist: add rate mapping `compact_credits` -> `RC_COMPACT_2026`, open PR on payments-service, and run dry-run: `make billing-migrate COHORT=compact-credits-expt DRY_RUN=1`. I will include rollback steps.

jamie_finance: Canary plan: 5% invoice volume first 24h -> 20% days 2-4 -> full at day 6 if metrics OK. Rollback triggers: >5% revenue delta in 24h, >1% increase in billing tickets, or any contract disputes.

tara_sales: I'll coordinate AM outreach and ensure flagged accounts are contacted 48h before go-live. Sophie, can you sign off on comms by Fri?

sophie_legal: Confirmed. Will post approved comms and a 3-line FAQ by Fri noon.

miguel_billing: Action items: run staging cohort (due 2026-07-01), produce exceptions sheet with proposed credits (due 2026-07-02), validate dry-run (due 2026-07-05). Preflight scheduled 2026-07-08.

jamie_finance: Great. If all green, go/no-go call 2026-07-11 16:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.
